\section{\texttt{summarize}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.benchmarking.summarize}\index{Functions!summarize}

Compute summary statistics for one phase from its per-repetition durations.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
summarize(phase: str, durations_ms: list[float]) -> PhaseStats
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{phase}] \texttt{str}, required. Phase name used as a label in the report.
  \item[\texttt{durations\_\allowbreak{}ms}] \texttt{list[float]\allowbreak{}}, required. Per-repetition durations in milliseconds (non-empty).
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{PhaseStats}. A \texttt{PhaseStats} with mean, median, p95, min, and max, each rounded to four decimal places.
\apifield{Raises}
\begin{arglist}

\end{arglist}
